title: Mixed Sizes Without Cropping
tests: Checks consistent vertical composition of landscape, square and portrait photos without cropping or distortion.

judge.summary: The visible frames show a clean, silent vertical photo reel with soft blurred fill, but the supplied samples do not establish whether the pastries photo appears.

must_haves.item: One silent 9:16 reel runs for approximately 10 seconds with no added text.
must_haves.why: The output is a single 10-second vertical clip with 9:16 framing, reported silent audio, and no visible added text.

must_haves.item: All five supplied photos appear in the requested order.
must_haves.why: The samples show storefront, latte, barista, and interior in the correct relative order; the pastries photo could appear between samples but is not shown.

must_haves.item: The landscape storefront, barista and interior photos retain their complete image boundaries.
must_haves.why: The storefront matches the complete supplied image. Barista and interior appear fitted as landscape images, but their source attachments are not shown for boundary comparison.

must_haves.item: The square latte and vertical pastries photos also remain fully visible, without cropping.
must_haves.why: The latte retains the complete square source image, but no output sample shows the pastries photo.

must_haves.item: Every foreground photo retains its original proportions, with no stretching or squashing.
must_haves.why: Storefront and latte preserve their source proportions, and the other visible photos show no obvious distortion; pastries is not visible and the remaining originals are unavailable for comparison.

must_haves.item: Unused canvas around fitted photos is filled with a soft blurred background rather than plain bars.
must_haves.why: All shown output frames use soft, image-derived blurred backgrounds above and below the foreground photos.
